name: Admin Document Edit
description: Edit an existing admin document, including its private notes. Entry from the Documents list carries the complete folder/filter/search/archive/view/page context into a validated `from` address; every editor exit returns there with a contextual label and restores the originating row/card, while native browser Back restores the same URL state. Direct or untrusted origins safely fall back to the Documents root. The compact doc-client-note-open entry opens a modal prefilled with email subject, email body, WhatsApp, and ordered custom title/content notes. Guardar cambios performs an immediate notes-only PATCH, confirms success visibly, and leaves unrelated page edits pending; no second page-level save is required. Failed or rejected saves keep the modal and draft open, while issued collection accounts expose the notes read-only. The existing content/status, client/project association, backlinks, Markdown clipboard toolbar, template-style preview, and dual PDF download remain available.
